contractTests.scope: Input validation, source/content noninterference, fatigue time invariance, abstention, and (in demo) frozen-profile/held-out content leakage.

abstentionPolicy: Abstain counts as rejection, including in owner/tired FRR.
uncertainty: Wilson intervals describe these finite synthetic trials only; not real people, devices, independent operators, or deployment accuracy.

speedMatchedMimic.design: Same 32 held-out mimic trials, with their source/input mode preserved and whole-session clocks rescaled to the observed normal-owner mean pointer speed in each style. No feature, model or threshold change.
speedMatchedMimic.statisticalLimit: Derived variants of the main mimic trials, not 32 additional independent observations; do not pool denominators.
speedMatchedMimic.meanSpeedUnits: Screen-fraction path length per second of motion (sum of click-delimited pointer paths / sum of their motion durations).

importantLimits: No real human data or accuracy validation.
A toy mimic copies easy first moments but not the full motor trajectory.
Recorded-event replay or an attacker who learns the complete feature distribution can bypass this offline classifier.
Insufficient coverage abstains and counts as owner rejection.
No claim that disabled users, eye gaze, switches or real dictation are validated by these fake styles.
